cases.input: Runs R1 and R2 cite future recipe revision rev-1 with distinct resolved effective-configuration digests.
cases.expect: Accepted only after allocation; rev-1 is shared while R1 and R2 remain distinct runs and no run fact becomes a recipe property.

cases.input: Recipe revision rev-1 and execution R1 are assigned one identifier and lifecycle.
cases.expect: Rejected; reusable specification and execution occurrence cannot share identity or lifecycle.

cases.input: An artifact references Reusable Training Recipe as an identified object while allocationState is 'unassigned'.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected. The candidate has no assigned identifier and no present independent identity; no identifier may be guessed or minted.

cases.input: A recipe in status 'draft' holds a revision in status 'draft' with no effectiveFrom and no currentRevisionRef.
cases.expect: Accepted once the candidate is allocated. effectiveFrom is required only from status 'effective' onward and currentRevisionRef only when some revision is effective.

cases.input: A recipe revision is set to 'superseded' with no successorRef and no effectiveTo.
cases.expect: Rejected. successorRef and effectiveTo are required when status is 'superseded'; a retired or superseded revision identifier remains resolvable and is never recycled.

cases.input: R1's metrics, checkpoints and compute actuals are recorded against recipe revision rev-1 and read as properties of R2.
cases.expect: Rejected. Recipe identity never inherits execution outcomes, checkpoints, metrics or resource actuals; two executions of one recipe remain two independently identified runs.
